title: gitops/charts/open-webui values
description: Structure only, on purpose (best-practices audit, lot 2): a key that holds a map by default stays a map (or null), a key that holds a list stays a list (or null). Scalars are NOT typed: Ansible renders integers and booleans as text in the AAP execution environment, and a typed scalar would turn that into a failed render. Every other key is allowed (additionalProperties), so a subchart's own values and a new value never need a schema change first. Tighten key by key, never loosen.
